+        if header_rows is None:
+            header_rows = ["name"]
+        super().__init__(delimiter_pad=None, bookend=False, header_rows=header_rows)
+        # For RST, the data starts after the header rows and position lines
+        # Structure: top_border, header_rows..., position_lines..., data_rows...
+        # With header_rows = ["name"]: top_border(0), name(1), position(2), data(3+)
+        # With header_rows = ["name", "unit"]: top_border(0), name(1), unit(2), position(3), data(4+)
+        # In general: 1 (top border) + len(header_rows) + 1 (position line) = 2 + len(header_rows)
+        self.data.start_line = 2 + len(header_rows)
 
     def write(self, lines):
         lines = super().write(lines)
-        lines = [lines[1]] + lines + [lines[1]]
+        # The position line is at index len(header_rows) in the output from parent's write()
+        header_rows = getattr(self.data, "header_rows", ["name"])
+        position_line_index = len(header_rows)
+        lines = [lines[position_line_index]] + lines + [lines[position_line_index]]
         return lines
